payload.text: hv's words on issue 0340, the suite's speed, 2026-11-12, read by date -u. (1) Relayed by kovacs-sysadm and dc: sweep bats --jobs N upward on both hosts. kovacs-sysadm swept kovacs at 8 to 64 over harness and fullcycle: 2 took 157 s, 8 took 40 to 46 s, 16 took 37.5 s (the knee), 24 took 38.0 s, 32 took 42.4 s and 48 or 64 took 56.4 s, all green. dc's rhadamanth sweep (slot 01M77MK9N07VTP2MSZ81T5AA1Y) started at 10:27:14Z. (2) In vc's window, about 10:29Z, hv's wording: 'It has to be _at least_ 16 if not 24 on rhad, no?' (3) To dc directly, relayed by dc, hv's wording: 'They don't run at the same time, so we should max out rhad to whatever is possible.' So 0340-1's floor is rhadamanth's fastest N from its sweep, at least 16, never held down to leave the kovacs VM room. dc's fact, given to hv: a cut starts its legs together (lib/cmd/release:1766, ST0011 AC-2.2), so kovacs's leg overlaps the local gates while they run. Separating them would change the legs step, which is outside 0340-1 and hv's to call. Open for hv on the bounce: CI sets DEVBIN_TEST_JOBS: all (.github/workflows/tests.yml:127, :253, :457), so CI keeps N at its own CPU count, and the new floor reaches CI only if that line changes. CI is the cut's long pole. (4) 0340-1 is built in dc's clone at 9a1670bf with the floor at eight, and is rebuilt with the swept floor before it banks.
